data.title: Changhong Jiahua Announces Agreement Renewals With Connected Parties
data.description:
Changhong Jiahua Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:3991) ) just unveiled an update.

Changhong Jiahua Holdings announced on 13 November 2026 that it had entered into renewed master supply and master purchase agreements with Sichuan Changhong Holding, each covering 1 January 2027 through 31 December 2029. Over the same term, wholly owned subsidiary Changhong IT entered into a renewed financial services agreement with Changhong Finance.

The arrangements are classified as continuing connected transactions under Hong Kong listing rules. The supply agreement requires reporting, annual review, announcement, circular and independent shareholders’ approval, while the purchase agreement requires reporting, annual review and announcement but is exempt from the latter two requirements. Deposit services under the financial services agreement are subject to reporting, annual review, announcement, circular and independent shareholders’ approval requirements, with the applicable percentage ratios for maximum daily outstanding balance exceeding 5%.

data.title: Wai Chun Bio-Technology Announces FY2026 Results and Resumption of Trading
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Wai Chun Bio-Technology Ltd. ( (HK:0660) ).

Wai Chun Bio-Technology Limited announced audited consolidated results for the year ended 30 June 2026, with comparative figures for the year ended 30 June 2025; the release also addresses resumption of trading. Revenue rose to HK$404.632 million from HK$377.168 million, while gross profit increased to HK$45.298 million from HK$36.004 million.

The Group reported profit of HK$31.760 million, compared with a loss of HK$10.701 million a year earlier. Profit attributable to company owners was HK$7.205 million, while total comprehensive income reached HK$36.636 million, versus a comprehensive expense of HK$9.701 million in 2025.

data.title: Zhengwei Group Proposes Share Capital Reduction and Subdivision
data.description:
Zhengwei Group Holdings Company Limited ( (HK:2147) ) just unveiled an update.

Zhengwei Group Holdings said its board proposes reducing the par value of each issued share from USD0.2 to HK$0.01 and subdividing each authorized but unissued share into 156 shares of HK$0.01. The company has 470.4 million issued shares, and the proposal would leave that number unchanged if no changes occur before effectiveness.

The credit arising from the reduction would be applied to accumulated losses. The company says its existing issued share capital of USD94.08 million would be reduced by approximately HK$729.12 million to HK$4.704 million, while the board considers the measures to be in the interests of the company and its shareholders.

data.title: China CDE Approves IND Application for Ab&B Bio-Tech Tetanus Vaccine Candidate
data.description:
Ab&B Bio-Tech CO., LTD. JS Class H ( (HK:2627) ) just unveiled an update.

Ab&B Bio-Tech is a China-based vaccine company focused on researching, developing, manufacturing and commercializing innovative and traditional vaccines using new technical methods. Its portfolio includes influenza and rabies vaccine candidates, alongside other products under development.

China’s Center for Drug Evaluation approved the Group’s Investigational New Drug application for its self-developed adsorbed tetanus vaccine candidate on November 12, 2026. The company said the approval marks advancement in traditional-vaccine research and lays the foundation for commencing clinical studies; trading in its Hong Kong-listed H shares has been suspended since April 1, 2026, until further notice.

data.title: Realord Completes Share Placing and Top-up Subscription
data.description:
Realord Group Holdings Limited ( (HK:1196) ) has shared an announcement.

Realord Technology Company Limited is a Bermuda-incorporated listed company with property development projects in Shenzhen and Grenada. The group says it can be asset-heavy at times, creating temporary mismatches between cash resources and immediate cash-settled liabilities.

The placing completed on 4 November 2026, with 952,380,000 existing shares placed with Ms. Kan Chi San at HK$0.21 each, making her a substantial shareholder. The top-up subscription completed on 13 November 2026, with the Seller subscribing for and the company issuing 952,380,000 new shares at HK$0.21 each.

Net proceeds from the top-up subscription amounted to approximately HK$197.2 million after expenses. The company said the transactions were conducted to raise new equity capital and improve liquidity after share-price and trading-volume volatility led contractors, creditors and suppliers to request interim payments, creating an imminent funding need.
